scientific_question: On the one frozen directed weighted routing instance, how do a lower-tail CVaR optimization objective and observable incremental depth, separately and jointly, change final solution concentration under the existing incumbent-product aligned-state/aligned-mixer Q2 algorithm?

hypotheses.statement: Holding depth policy fixed, CVaR(0.25) changes final p_opt and p_feas relative to expectation optimization.
Holding objective mode fixed and total objective-evaluation budget at 300, incremental p=1->2->3 changes final p_opt and p_feas relative to fixed p=3.
The change associated with CVaR(0.25) differs between fixed and incremental depth policies.

interpretation_scope.inference: deterministic instance-specific factorial contrasts; no population-level or quantum-advantage claim

frozen_historical_q2.incumbent_construction: deterministic lightest outgoing edge that can still reach the target; ties by node id
frozen_historical_q2.parameter_order: all gammas followed by all betas
frozen_historical_q2.cost_hamiltonian: historical fixed directed-flow QUBO mapped with x_i=(1-Z_i)/2 and the historical affine normalization
frozen_historical_q2.decoder: historical independent directed source-to-target route decoder

levels.cutoff: partial probability atom at the discrete cutoff

depth_factor.first_transfer: p=2 is attempted after p=1 whenever the arm has a finite retained p=1 result and budget remains; p=1 optimizer progress is recorded but is not a depth gain and does not gate p=2
depth_factor.p3_decision: attempt p=3 if and only if both p=2 gain conditions pass and budget remains

optimizer.name: COBYLA
optimizer.draw_order: all gamma coordinates then all beta coordinates

seed_policy.policy: one historical seeded start per arm

objective_call_accounting.initial_diagnostic: computed once, cached as COBYLA's first request, and charged exactly once
objective_call_accounting.neutral_transfer_diagnostic: computed once, cached as COBYLA's first request at the transferred depth, and charged exactly once
objective_call_accounting.optimizer_requests: every COBYLA request counts, including an out-of-bounds penalty request
objective_call_accounting.final_metric_calculations: not optimizer objective calls; reported separately with statevector-evaluation accounting

endpoints.exact_optimum_use: final p_opt evaluation only; prohibited from alpha, epsilon, depth, stopping, optimizer, seed, or run-retention decisions

stopping_rules.fixed: one optimization at the declared fixed depth, stopping on historical COBYLA convergence/failure or the declared hard objective-evaluation cap
stopping_rules.incremental_p1: retain the finite p=1 result and attempt p=2 if budget remains; p=1 progress does not gate depth
stopping_rules.incremental_p2: attempt p=3 only when marginal_depth_gain_relative > 0.01 and marginal_depth_gain_absolute > 1e-12 and budget remains
stopping_rules.early_stop_budget: unused budget is not reallocated to another depth, arm, or seed
stopping_rules.hard_failure: stop the affected arm on non-finite objective, neutral-transfer equivalence violation, or unrecoverable execution error

failure_retention.evaluation_budget_exhaustion: retain best finite parameters as the depth result
failure_retention.hard_failure: record the failure, completed trace, consumed budget, and stop reason

primary_contrasts: objective main effect averaged descriptively across depth policies
depth-policy main effect averaged descriptively across objectives
reporting.diagnostic_controls: fixed p=1 and fixed p=2 budget-matched runs for both objective modes

prohibited_post_hoc_changes: change alpha or add a primary alpha sweep
change p_max, transfer, or depth trigger after inspecting outcomes
add, remove, or replace seeds or multistarts
change optimizer, bounds, initialization, rhobeg, or tolerance
select an arm or depth using p_opt or the known optimum
reinterpret smoke data as confirmatory evidence
replace p_feas, p_opt, or ordinary expectation with CVaR
claim the combined ingredients as novel

required_before_formal_run: historical Q2 versus A0 state and optimizer-trajectory equivalence tests pass
neutral-transfer equivalence and objective-accounting tests pass
separate user authorization to run the formal experiment
